content.intro: Responsive communication, modern tools and permit-ready plans you can build on.

content.text: Structural Integrity Engineering is a structural engineering practice specializing in custom residential design, low-rise commercial projects and glazing and mullion engineering. We provide fast, accurate and affordable permit-ready drawings and calculations for builders, architects and homeowners in Colorado.

content.heading: Meet our principal engineer
content.body: Dylan Gassmann is the founder and principal engineer of Structural Integrity Engineering. Based in Colorado Springs, he brings a decade of hands-on experience in structural engineering for residential and commercial projects. He believes great engineering should move projects forward: quickly, clearly and affordably.
